ns2:course.label: Content Creation
ns2:course.description: Explores theories of creativity; situates creativity and creative practices within the social structure of organizations that develop creative content; examines the relationship between creative strategy, creative concepts and creative executions; exposes students to the practice of creating content for traditional and non-traditional media vehicles. Credit is not given for ADV 390 if credit for ADV 450 has been earned. Prerequisite: ADV 283.
